text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I never even imagined finishing
in such a mediocre position. But—

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: There won't be a next time.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Huh? Don't underestimate me.
I'm aiming even higher.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
I'll make you regret
snapping at meâ

Sirius Symboli's eyes held the wild glint of a predator,
taking my breath away.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: The next victor will be me.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text: Ha, look at you talking big now.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Still, it's not enough.
Next time, I'm "definitely" going to win.

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
We're going to do everything humanly possible.
Anyone who can't keep up gets left behind without mercy. Got it?

text_block_list.name: Sirius Symboli
text_block_list.text:
Follow me like your life depends on it.
—I'll show you the view that belongs only to the victor.
